data.standardized_narrative: During calendar year 2020 the syndicate recorded a net prior-year favourable reassessment (a net surplus) of approximately GBP 52.0m relating to previous accident years, driven by favourable backyear reserve releases and benign claims experience in certain classes (notably some Casualty and Marine portfolios). At the same time the syndicate strengthened reserves and incurred significant pandemic-related losses on contingency/event cancellation and other books (largely written to 2019), and suffered a number of 2020 weather catastrophes. The net effect reported was a prior-year release (net) while overall calendar year reserves increased driven by current-year events and COVID-19 exposures; the gross prioryear movement by insurer-liabilities was not explicitly provided in the report (the GBP 51.972m figure is reported net of reinsurance).

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (insurance-liabilities column) was not explicitly reported. The report explicitly states a prior-year surplus of GBP 51.972m but that is net of reinsurance. A gross PYD figure could not be located in the disclosed movement notes; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m above uses the explicitly stated NET prior-year surplus and is flagged accordingly. Claims development triangle is present but includes an 'X and prior' aggregate column and complex rows (and the RITC / closed year activity in the underwriting year accounts may distort direct triangle extraction). All monetary figures in the statements are presented in thousands in the source; values here are converted to millions.
